items.name: reveal
items.title: Reveal
items.description: Brings an element forward as it scrolls into view, tied to the scroll: rise, tilt, scale, blur or slide.
items.docs: Pure CSS scroll-driven animation: nothing is hidden before hydration, and reduced motion or a browser without scroll timelines shows the element at rest. Give a row of reveals an increasing order to land them in sequence. Clip a parent with overflow: clip, never overflow: hidden: a hidden overflow makes that parent the scroll container the timeline follows, and the animation stands still.

items.name: parallax-layer
items.title: Parallax Layer
items.description: A layer that travels at its own pace while the page scrolls past, with optional zoom and turn.
items.docs: Put layers with different speeds in one relatively positioned section. Keep speeds between -0.6 and 0.6 for text, and use the stronger values for shapes and images. Clip a parent with overflow: clip, never overflow: hidden: a hidden overflow makes that parent the scroll container the timeline follows, and the animation stands still.

items.name: scroll-progress
items.title: Scroll Progress
items.description: A thin reading bar that fills as you scroll the page or a scrolling panel.
items.docs: Sticky at the top of its container. Uses a CSS scroll timeline where available and a passive scroll listener elsewhere. Decorative, so hidden from assistive technology.

items.name: text-reveal
items.title: Text Reveal
items.description: A statement that lights up word by word as it scrolls through the screen.
items.docs: For the one sentence a page is built around. Screen readers read the sentence whole. Give it room above and below, so the words have scroll to light up in. Clip a parent with overflow: clip, never overflow: hidden: a hidden overflow makes that parent the scroll container the timeline follows, and the animation stands still.
